info.title: FormLaw API
info.description: FormLaw — agentic legal workbench for lawyers. Evidence is the source of truth; the backend enforces security.

post.summary: Sign in as a DEMO persona (DEMO_MODE only)

get.description:
Matter register for firm owners/admins: which matters exist, their status and who leads them. Deliberately no
title, client name, description, documents or findings — those need case membership granted by the matter lead.
Text of each page as chunks, for the evidence viewer. Highlight targets are chunk ids.

post.summary: Search judgments, constitutional Articles, sections, rules and regulations
Grounded answer from the verified corpus (claims → evidence → document → source)

get.summary: What the legal corpus actually contains (no inflated claims)

delete.description: Clients control their own uploads. Copies already in an advocate's case are the advocate's record and stay there.

post.description: Organise the client's own files: what each is, a dated timeline, conflicting dates and missing documents.

get.description: Which connection features are available, why, and the disclosures a client must see before sharing a matter.

post.description: Sharing the matter with a lawyer is HIGH risk: this creates an approval the client must confirm.

get.description:
Until the advocate clears the conflict check they see only what a conflict check needs: the names involved, the
matter type, city and urgency. The summary, title, documents count and the client's note stay hidden.

post.description: E.g. a Bar Council reports the enrolment suspended, or verification evidence is found to be false.

get.description: Every advocate account with its verification state (profile data only — no case or client data).

post.description: Emergency switch-off (falls back to the safe default unless another approved version exists).
